svg.text: The agent's main decision process. While it listens, operators read the human's utterance and RecognizeIntent pushes its intent onto the intent stack. While it works,
only the top of the stack decides which operator applies. Operators keep applying until one ends the turn, and the agent listens again.
Arrows: what usually applies next, labelled with the state that lets it.
